 9:35 AM ET an hour ago West Ham and Southampton Battle for Three Important Points
 West Ham United enter this match in second place in the standings and will look to extend their strong run under head coach Nuno Espírito Santo. The Hammers are coming off victories against Lincoln City and Swansea City and will aim to take advantage of home-field advantage to remain near the top of the table. Jarrod Bowen, one of the team's main attacking threats, will be a player to watch.
 Southampton, meanwhile, sit in eighth place and will look to earn points in a challenging away fixture. The team managed by Tonda Eckert relies on possession and counterpressing to compete against the hosts. Finn Azaz, known for his creativity and ability to create chances from midfield, will be one of the Saints' key players.

 9:21 AM ET an hour ago How to watch West Ham vs Southampton Live: TV Channel and Online?
 In Mexico and the rest of South America , the match will be available on Disney+ Premium , with ESPN broadcasts depending on each country's schedule. In Mexico , it will be available through Disney+, according to the platform's regional offering.
 In the United States , fans can follow the match through Paramount+ and CBS networks. In the United Kingdom, the game will not be broadcast live on television.
 On VAVEL, you can follow the preview, official lineups, statistics, and the main match developments through our traditional Minute-by-Minute coverage , with updates throughout the game.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 9:12 AM ET an hour ago Injuries and team news
 West Ham's main concern is Keiber Lamadrid, who continues to recover from a knee injury. The Venezuelan midfielder is reportedly close to returning, although his availability for this match remains to be confirmed.
 For Southampton, Flynn Downes remains doubtful with an ankle injury, while Cyle Larin will be assessed after experiencing a hamstring issue against Bolton. Their availability will be important for Tonda Eckert's options ahead of the match.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 9:02 AM ET 2 hours ago Key factors in West Ham vs Southampton
 West Ham will look to impose their attacking tempo and take advantage of set pieces. With Bowen posing a major threat and Mavropanos providing an aerial presence, the hosts have several ways to create scoring opportunities.
 Southampton, meanwhile, will need to preserve the defensive organization they have shown in recent matches. Azaz's ability to link up with the forwards and Scienza's pace could prove decisive when exploiting spaces. Efficiency at both ends of the pitch will play a crucial role in determining the outcome.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 8:55 AM ET 2 hours ago Head-to-head record between West Ham and Southampton
 The two teams last met on August 25, 2026, in the second round of the English League Cup. West Ham claimed a 4-1 victory at St Mary's Stadium, securing their place in the next round.
 This time, the circumstances will be different, with three Championship points at stake and both sides looking to move closer to the promotion places. Southampton will aim to bounce back from that defeat, while the Hammers will look to repeat their previous success.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 8:30 AM ET 2 hours ago Southampton: looking to make a statement in London
 Southampton arrive after a goalless draw against Bolton Wanderers. That result extended their run to three consecutive matches without conceding, a positive sign for Tonda Eckert's side as they look to establish themselves among the promotion contenders.
 However, the Saints face a tough test against one of the division's most productive attacks. Finn Azaz will be important in creating chances, while Léo Scienza will provide pace and creativity on the wings. Southampton will need to maintain their defensive solidity and capitalize on the opportunities they create.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 7:45 AM ET 3 hours ago West Ham United: extending their positive run
 Nuno Espírito Santo's side arrive after securing two consecutive away victories, thrashing Lincoln City 6-0 before beating Swansea City 1-0. The latter result extended their unbeaten run in the Championship to nine matches.
 Jarrod Bowen is one of the Hammers' leading attacking players, with six goals and four assists in the competition. Konstantinos Mavropanos has also made an impact, contributing five goals from defense. West Ham will aim to maintain their attacking efficiency and use the support of their fans to secure another three points.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 7:45 AM ET 3 hours ago West Ham and Southampton look to climb the Championship table
 West Ham sit second in the Championship with 22 points from 11 matches, having recorded six wins, four draws, and one defeat. The London side have scored 30 goals and conceded 12, highlighting their attacking strength throughout the campaign.
 Southampton, meanwhile, sit eighth with 17 points, having recorded six wins, three draws, and two defeats. The Saints began the season with a four-point administrative deduction and will look to keep collecting points to close the gap on the promotion places.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 7:45 AM ET 3 hours ago London Stadium, the venue for West Ham vs Southampton
 London Stadium, located in Stratford, east London, has an approximate capacity of 62,000 spectators. It has been West Ham United's home ground since 2016 and will host a matchup between two clubs aiming to return to the Premier League. The Hammers will look to take advantage of home-field advantage to extend their positive run and remain in the race for the top spot.
